claim_boundary: This boundary records multi-objective readiness criteria tied to the bounded multi-objective search matrix. It does not claim primary Pareto/frontier archive replacement, durable cross-run metric database, calibrated parent/inspiration balance, stable behavior descriptor contracts, learned or evaluator-provided descriptor models, tested archive rebin semantics, durable duplicate-work memory, semantic near-duplicate detection, metric-specific CLI drill-downs, equal-budget multi-objective benchmarks, stale-readiness detector, or owner review signoff.

readiness_criteria.current_scope: scalar-primary MAP-Elites grid with bounded Pareto/frontier and metric-cell overlays
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: archive-policy matrix proving primary Pareto/frontier archive replacement or an equivalent tested multi-objective policy
readiness_criteria.search_surface: primary archive policy, Pareto/frontier replacement, and metric-cell retention

readiness_criteria.current_scope: cross-run paper metric reports and selected summary artifacts
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: durable cross-run metric database and persisted metric-specific optimization records
readiness_criteria.search_surface: cross-run metric database, metric bundles, and persisted benchmark artifacts

readiness_criteria.current_scope: current-run strategy counts and prompt-visible metric-niche evidence
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: calibrated parent/inspiration balance and equal-budget prompt-policy evidence
readiness_criteria.search_surface: metric-diverse inspiration, parent selection, and prompt-policy comparisons
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: calibrated sampling balance and prompt-policy benchmark

readiness_criteria.current_scope: insertion-time TF-IDF/default axes or configured numeric axes with false readiness flags
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: stable behavior descriptor contracts, learned/evaluator descriptor models, and tested archive rebin semantics
readiness_criteria.search_surface: behavior descriptors, descriptor models, MAP-Elites axes, and archive rebinning
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: stable descriptor authority and rebin semantics

readiness_criteria.current_scope: run-local exact-workspace evaluator cache and no-op cache-hit events
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: durable duplicate-work memory and semantic near-duplicate detection
readiness_criteria.search_surface: duplicate-work cache, resurfacing indexes, semantic near-duplicates, and resume replay
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: durable duplicate-work memory with semantic near-duplicate policy

readiness_criteria.current_scope: selected-row show summaries and manifest-level metric archive summaries
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: metric-specific CLI drill-downs and durable query/report surfaces
readiness_criteria.search_surface: metric-specific CLI drill-downs, selected-row summaries, and durable query surfaces
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: metric-specific CLI drill-down and report policy

readiness_criteria.current_scope: boundary records without equal-budget multi-objective benchmark curves
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: equal-budget multi-objective benchmarks with scalar-only and single-metric baselines
readiness_criteria.search_surface: scalar baselines, single-metric baselines, and equal-budget multi-objective benchmarks

readiness_criteria.current_scope: bounded inventories and TODO ownership sidecars without owner signoff
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: stale-readiness detector and owner signoff before multi-objective parity claims
readiness_criteria.search_surface: README, ROADMAP, papers, archive reports, runtime metadata, and owner readiness claims
